name: To Orgrimmar!
label: Quest
description: Kaplak sends a young rogue from Razor Hill to Orgrimmar. There, you are to find Shenthul in the Cleft of Shadow and enter the Shattered Hand's network.

clips.title: The story
paras: Kaplak sends a young rogue from Razor Hill to Orgrimmar. There, you are to find Shenthul in the Cleft of Shadow and enter the Shattered Hand's network.

Kaplak sends you north from Razor Hill to Orgrimmar. Your budding skills have caught the notice of more prominent handlers, though they remain unpolished. The red crags of Durotar are behind you as you make for the capital.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A master of stealth and deception you are not, however, all of that can and will change. You've obviously impressed those in charge with your meager skills, as the great Shenthul has asked for you by name.
Take the road north of here to Orgrimmar and speak with Shenthul in the Cleft of Shadow.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It is important that the Shattered Hand remains vigilant in the face of the changes Thrall wishes to bring about to the Horde. Our numbers alone will not be enough to overcome his rule - stealth and deception must be mastered.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
